import ctypes
import os

def assert_test():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
    libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

    assert os.path.exists(libgslcblas_path), f"Library not found: {libgslcblas_path}"
    assert os.path.exists(libgsl_path), f"Library not found: {libgsl_path}"

    ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

    # Access the 'gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre' symbol
    try:
        gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre = ctypes.cast(
            ctypes.addressof(gsl.gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre),
            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)
        )
        assert gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre, "Failed to load 'gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre' symbol."
        print("'gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre' symbol loaded successfully.")
    except AttributeError:
        raise AssertionError("Symbol 'gsl_integration_fixed_laguerre' not found in the library.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
